map.录入电梯井、楼梯间、走廊等各公摊部位面积，工具汇总公摊总面积、计算公摊系数，并按: Enter the area of each shared part such as lift shafts, stairwells, and corridors; the tool totals the shared area, computes the shared area coefficient, allocates it to each unit by floor area, and gives the usable area ratio so buyers can check whether the title area breakdown is compliant.
map.开发商或物业按测绘报告把整栋公摊面积按套内面积比例分摊到各户: The developer or management company allocates the building's total shared area across units in proportion to their internal area, based on the survey report
map.二手房交易前复核公摊系数是否合理（住宅通常 10%–20%）: Before a second-hand property transaction, check whether the shared area coefficient is reasonable (usually 10%–20% for housing)
map.业委会质疑公摊过大时，逐部位核对电梯井、楼梯、大堂等: When the owners committee questions an excessive shared area, check each part item by item: lift shafts, stairwells, lobbies, and so on
map.：整栋套内 8000 ㎡、公摊 1200 ㎡ → 公摊系数 = 1200 / 8: : With 8000 ㎡ of internal area in the building and 1200 ㎡ of shared area, the shared area coefficient = 1200 / 8000 = 15%; a unit with 100 ㎡ internal area gets 100 × 15% = 15 ㎡ shared, so the title area = 115 ㎡.
map.：电梯井 400 + 楼梯间 300 + 大堂 200 + 设备层 300 =: : Lift shaft 400 + stairwell 300 + lobby 200 + plant room 300 = 1200 ㎡, allocated in proportion to internal area; the largest item is the lift shaft, 33.3% of the shared area.
map.公摊面积详细核算（含各部位）: Detailed shared area calculation (with each part listed)
map.公摊系数多少算正常？: What Shared Area Coefficient Is Normal?
map.多层住宅约 10%–15%，高层 15%–25%；超过 25% 需核查是否有不应: Low-rise and mid-rise housing is roughly 10%–15% and high-rise 15%–25%; above 25% check whether parts that should not count have been included.
map.公摊面积能自己测量吗？: Can I Measure the Shared Area Myself?
map.不能，须以有资质测绘机构的报告为准；本工具用于复核分摊计算是否正确，不代表重新测: No, only a report from a qualified surveying organization counts; this tool checks whether the allocation calculation is right and is not a new survey.
